ひいた.es: cogió (un resfriado), pasado de ひく

そうです.en: It seems that; they say that

に違いありません.en: without a doubt; it must be

texto: To say that something is the logical conclusion of what you know: phrase in normal form + **わけ だ**: **かぜ を ひいた わけ です ね** (so he took a cold, right?).

bloques.titulo: In this case, the Commission is not in a position to consider whether or not the Commission is in a position to take the necessary measures to ensure that the Commission is in a position to ensure that it is in a position to do so.
texto: To say that something is impossible according to what you know: phrase in normal form + **わけ が ない**: **そんな こと が ある わけ が ありません** (something like this cannot happen).
It also expresses a strong negative conclusion; **はずがない** may sound equally firm according to context.

bloques.titulo: No, it does not mean that
texto: To say that what you see is not what it looks like: phrase in normal form + **わけ では ない**: **いそがしい わけ では ありません** (not that it is very busy).
It serves to correct a wrong idea.

filas: ひいた わけ です
ある わけ が ありません
いそがしい わけ では ありません

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: that's why and it can't be

frases.ja: やまだ さん が いません。 なるほど、 かぜ を ひいた わけ です ね。
frases.es: Yamada no está. Ya veo, así que cogió un resfriado, ¿verdad?
frases.en: Yamada's not here. I see, so you took a cold, right?
analisis: かぜ を ひいた わけ です ね

frases.ja: そんな こと が ある わけ が ありません。
frases.es: No puede ser que pase algo así.
frases.en: It can't be that something like that happens.
analisis: そんな こと が ある わけ が ありません
It can't be that something like that happens.

frases.ja: いそがしい わけ では ありません。
frases.es: No es que esté muy ocupado.
analisis: いそがしい わけ では ありません

frases.ja: 玄関 に ぬれた 靴 が あります。外 は もう 晴れています が、道 に 水たまり が あります。少し 前 に 雨 が 降った に違いありません。近所 の 人 も 傘 を 持って 帰った そうです。
frases.es: Hay zapatos mojados en la entrada. Ya hace sol, pero quedan charcos en la calle. Debió de llover hace poco. Según parece, un vecino también volvió con un paraguas.
frases.en: There are wet shoes in the entrance. It's sunny now, but there are puddles left on the street. It must have rained recently. It seems that a neighbor also returned with an umbrella.

bloques.pregunta: What does the person get when they see the wet shoes?

opciones.texto: That the rain will continue for several days
opciones.explicacion: The text infers that it rained recently, but no more rain is announced.

opciones.texto: That the neighbor came back by train
opciones.explicacion: The neighbor's means of transport are not indicated.

bloques.pregunta: What other information do you have?

opciones.texto: Which, it seems, a neighbor came back with an umbrella.
opciones.explicacion: The answer appears in the reading.

opciones.texto: That the neighbor came back without an umbrella
opciones.explicacion: The reading says he came back with an umbrella.

opciones.texto: That the neighbor lives next door
opciones.explicacion: You can't explain where he lives.

bloques.pregunta: What does «かぜ を ひいた わけ です ね» mean?

opciones.texto: So you took a cold, right?
opciones.explicacion: The Commission has also taken the view that the Commission is not in a position to take the necessary measures to ensure that the Commission is in a position to ensure that the Commission is able to take the necessary measures to ensure that it is in a position to ensure that the Commission is in a position to do so.

opciones.texto: He took a cold, and I don't know.

opciones.explicacion: It's impossible as far as you know.
That would be the only way.

bloques.pregunta: I see, so he took a cold.
bloques.frase: やまだ さん が いません。 なるほど、 かぜ を ___ わけ です。

bloques.pregunta: It can't be that something like that happens.
bloques.frase: そんな こと が ある ___ 。

opciones.texto: わけ が ありません

bloques.frase: いそがしい わけ では ありません。

opciones.texto: He's busy, that's why he's not coming.

bloques.audio: やまだ さん が いません。 なるほど、 かぜ を ひいた わけ です ね。

opciones.texto: That you see why Yamada is not here: she took a cold.

bloques.frase: そんな こと が ある わけ が ありません
bloques.traduccion: It can't be that something like that happens.
bloques.explicacion: In this case, it is not possible to do so.

bloques.pregunta: What does «わけ では ない» mean?

opciones.explicacion: That would be the only way.

intro: Today you learn to draw conclusions: when you understand why something is going on, when something cannot be true and when it is not what it seems. They are very used phrases when speaking.
